description: Defines classes TDT and TOT for handling DVB time and date information, including parsing from MPEG sections.

classes.name: TDT
classes.description: Represents the DVB Time and Date Table, parses date/time from MPEG section data.

classes.name: TOT
classes.description: Time Offset Table extending TDT, provides access to descriptors.

methods.name: TDT(const MPEG::Section& data)
methods.description: Constructs TDT object by parsing MPEG section data to extract date/time.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the parsed time is valid.

methods.name: TOT(const MPEG::Section& data)
methods.description: Constructs TOT object from MPEG section data.

methods.name: Descriptors()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over MPEG descriptors in the TOT.
